iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

TAP_REQUEST
       Threat Analytics Platform event once security token obtained. Changing score or action re-evaluates TAP enforcement logic.

DESCRIPTION
       Triggered after obtaining a security token for certain HTTP transaction

Examples
	when TAP_REQUEST {
	    if {[TAP::score] > 85} {
	       drop
	    }
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-15.0 --First introduced the event.
